title: Towards More Accountable Search Engines: Online Evaluation of Representation Bias
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its findings are focused on gender representation bias in search results for professions.

measurement_description: The paper does not measure aspects of faith or religion. The benchmark measures gender representation bias in Google's Knowledge Graph search results for various professions.
